definition: In reference to law, “voluntary” is used to indicate willfulness or intention. For example:  “Voluntary waste” is the willful act of damaging a property or depleting natural resources available on the property.  “Voluntary manslaughter” is the intentional killing of another person while in the heat of passion or with adequate provocation.  “Voluntary bankruptcy” is bankruptcy that is filed for by the debtor, rather than by the creditor.
